text:
maya (partnerships): Quick sync — partners asked for a single compatibility matrix we can publish for marketplace + SI docs. Can eng confirm pinned driver/CUDA/ROCm combos we recommend for GA?

samir (eng-runtime): We have a candidate set but need to lock before the joint announcement. Basic principle: pick two CUDA versions (one LTS), one ROCm, and driver pins for the oldest supported GPU families.

julie (product): Timeline: marketing wants the announcement aligned with marketplace listing next Tue (2025-10-21). That means final matrix + tested images by EOD Friday. Is that doable? :calendar:

samir (eng-runtime): Tight but doable if we triage regressions today. Proposed matrix draft:```
- CUDA: 12.1 (preferred), 11.8 (compat)
- NVIDIA driver: 535.xx for CUDA12, 520.xx for CUDA11
- ROCm: 5.7 (preferred)
- AMD firmware: recommend customers use ROCm 5.7-compatible kernels (>=5.15)
```

nate (sre): We also need marketplace VM/container images pinned to those driver builds. If we change driver after publish, marketplace approvals take days. Suggest we include a delta plan for hotfixes.

vincent (nvidia-partner): Confirming 535.xx is the validated driver for 40/30 series on our side. We'll run the Redwood test harness against 535.43 and 520.61 for regression checks. Can you share the CI job defs?

samir (eng-runtime): Sharing job defs now in eng-ci. Example job snippet:```yaml
- name: integration-gpu-matrix
  matrix:
    cuda: [12.1, 11.8]
    driver: [535.43, 520.61]
  steps:
    - run: ./scripts/run_inference_smoke.sh --cuda ${{matrix.cuda}} --driver ${{matrix.driver}}
```

deploy-bot: Build 2025-10-12_09:02:17 started for image redwood/inference:marketplace-1752

alexa (aws-partner): From marketplace side: images must pass our security scan and driver licensing check. If you pin to 535, include a short note in the listing about driver source URL and checksum. Also we prefer drivers bundled as separate AMI/kernel module packages rather than modifying stock kernels.

julie (product): Also need messaging for SIs: call out recommended pins, known incompatible stacks, and a rollback plan. Let's draft a short one-pager they can attach to integration docs.

samir (eng-runtime): Noted. On regressions: if we see perf regressions on CUDA12+535 we fallback to 520 for the canary pool and open hotfix branch. Hotfix process: create branch hotfix/driver-<driver>-<date>, run fast smoke + perf compare, if pass, push to marketplace image and notify partners.

maya (partnerships): Can partners commit to running the smoke matrix by EOD Thursday? We need partner sign-off to publish. @vincent @alexa

vincent (nvidia-partner): We'll run smoke by Thu EOD. If we find a regression, we'll file a joint issue and assign to Samir.

alexa (aws-partner): AWS imaging team can run the scans by Thu as well. If anything fails we'll flag marketplace hold and notify Julie for messaging.

nate (sre): I'll prepare a rollback playbook for marketplace images and a one-click revert in case of severe regressions. Will post link here when ready.

samir (eng-runtime): Thanks — I'll share final pinned matrix + test results Friday morning. Also attaching a short checklist we should publish with the matrix:```
- validated GPU families
- kernel version ranges
- driver checksums
- known issues / mitigations
- hotfix contact and SLAs
```

maya (partnerships): Perfect. Once we have partner sign-offs and the checklist, marketing will greenlight joint announcement. I'll schedule a 30m sync Friday 9:30am to finalize copy. :white_check_mark:
